_comment: Protocol paths only. These are part of the wire contract, defined in
internal/protocol and served by the /ssso/* handlers,
and are identical in every deployment, so they are tracked in git.
Service ADDRESSES (including the former Issuer / DockerIssuer pair) are NOT set
here — they come from the ORION_* environment variables and are applied by
RuntimeConfig.ApplyEnv at startup. Editing an address here would have no effect;
